body:
Added POST /portal/login (PortalHandler.LocalLogin) -- real bcrypt-verified email+password sign-in against local_users, setting a real HttpOnly iduna_session cookie, matching AdminLoginHandler's own pattern. Granted devportal.access to both real local_users accounts. portalLoginTmpl now renders a real form alongside the existing Google button. Founder real-time pivot (2026-08-28): 'get the developer portal working with iduna login instead of just the google oauth' -- Google OAuth stays deferred (blocked on a human-only GCP Console step). webmaster's local_users password hash reset in the live DB (old hash unrecoverable); new credential reported directly to founder. go build/vet/test ./... all clean. Commits: d562551 (feature), ee1ac7c (changelog). Deploy queued: sudo-queue/32-restart-iduna-for-portal-local-login.sh.

⚓ ☃
title: Real IDUNA login for the developer notebook portal
